GenAiPlanner.description: The Property Agent specializes in delivering personalized property discovery experiences based on customer preferences. Leveraging rich inventory data, it presents tailored property options and responds to detailed inquiries about features, amenities, and specifications. Customers can explore properties through immersive virtual tours and side-by-side comparisons of key attributes. The agent also facilitates scheduling of physical property viewings and refines recommendations by tracking interest signals and engagement patterns. With a deep understanding of both customer needs and property inventory, it ensures an informed, convenient, and engaging property search journey. Area insights and neighborhood data are also provided to assist in decision-making, while seamless integration with other agents enables a smooth handoff to transactional stages.
